_comment: The reviewed schema policy for ONE corpus — the 'LLM reads the schema' step of the Source-Data Ingestion Principle, held as DATA beside the corpus's own declaration rather than as a dict inside the generic generator. Read by `python scripts/corpus_to_ak.py --corpus mobility`. Adding a dataset is a file here, not an edit there.
_id_field_note: the REAL id column — the upstream manifest's `respondent_id` is absent from the rows
_index_fields_note: coded/categorical → grouping Sets, so a group-by is a Set read and never a JSON parse. A FOCUSED set of analytical dimensions, not every column: any other coded field stays queryable by parse-on-demand from the raw JSON (cached by analysis.*), so this list is a size lever, not a completeness constraint. ~8 fields → ~9 set.adds per row.
_text_fields_note: free-text / natural language → weavable txt: atoms (the Weaver's legitimate targets; they carry no raw marker).
